blocks.text: Days 11–13 · Free days for the beach. The coast of Pernambuco is famous for the natural pools that form among the reefs at low tide, where you can swim and watch fish and corals. Surfers will find beaches with waves of up to 2 metres, and Maracaípe beach regularly hosts surfing competitions; windsurfing and water-skiing are also popular. A few kilometres offshore lies Santo Aleixo Island, well known to divers, while Muro Alto is a huge natural pool sheltered by reefs, a natural aquarium full of colourful fish. Restaurants serve fresh fish, and in the evening the village offers traditional shows, bars and nightlife.
